props.heading: How we work
props.body:
We meet you before the day, at the studio or on a call, and go through it hour by hour: who needs to be in which photo, when the light is best, where the families will stand.

On the day there are two of us, so the sagun and the guests get covered while the couple is being photographed. Every photo you receive is chosen and edited by one of us, not a filter.

items.q: How much do we pay to book?
items.a: Thirty percent holds the date. The rest is due a week after the wedding, once you have seen the preview photos.

items.q: Do you travel to Pokhara, Chitwan or India?
items.a: Yes. We add the travel and a room at cost, and nothing else.

items.q: When do we get the photos?
items.a: Fifty preview photos within a week, the full online gallery within three weeks, the album within eight.

items.q: Can we choose the photos for the album?
items.a: Yes. You mark your favourites in the online gallery and we design the album around them, with one round of changes.

pages.title: About
pages.seoDescription: Anish and Rejina Maharjan have photographed weddings, families and food in the Kathmandu Valley since 2072.

image.alt: A camera body and two lenses on a dark table

props.heading: Two photographers, one small studio in Patan
props.body:
Anish learned on a borrowed film camera in Nag Bahal; Rejina came from newspaper work. We started Tole Studio in the room above Anish's family shop and still work from there.

We take a limited number of weddings each season so that the two of us can shoot every one of them ourselves.
